content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to connect an expansion module (for example, with article number [article_no]) with an older version of the control unit ([article_no])? Is it necessary to upgrade the CPU for compatibility? Thank you for clarifying. Best regards, [user_name]

Expansion modules with article numbers ending in 0BA0 or 0BA1 are incompatible with controllers using version 0BA8. Likewise, expansion modules ending in 0BA2 are not supported by controllers earlier than version 0BA8. Therefore, 0BA2 modules will not work with the 0BA6 version; you would need to update the controller to 0BA8 to use these modules.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clarity on backward compatibility between newer expansion modules and previous generation controllers. There is confusion due to compatibility differences associated with specific article numbers, notably that modules labeled with 0BA2 are incompatible with older controller versions like 0BA6. This highlights a frequent concern regarding clear communication of compatibility requirements, which can present challenges for those maintaining or upgrading legacy automation systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect either backward compatibility or, at the very least, explicit and easy-to-understand documentation detailing which expansion modules correspond to specific controller module versions.
